reviews.title: No tides data provided
reviews.text: I’ll be asking for a refund for this app as there are no tide times or graphs provided. Last data available was December 30th and today is January 4th. At this, the busiest time of the boating year the support from either LINZ or the developer has dropped off.

Is 2026 the end of Tides NZ? We have lost the deep blue sine wave and assume the 2026 data is sadly missing. 
I am sad! It was a great app!

reviews.title: App no longer shows any information
reviews.text: The app is currently not working, seems yo be an end of year thing as it happens every year. Come on get this sorted, has happened too many time now!
